description: This file defines the custom exception class ViewHandlerException used within the web application, extending a general exception class and providing multiple constructors for different exception scenarios.

classes.name: ViewHandlerException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for handling view-related errors within the web application, extending GeneralException.

methods.name: ViewHandlerException()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an instance with no message or cause.

methods.name: ViewHandlerException(String msg)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a message describing the exception.

methods.name: ViewHandlerException(Throwable t)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps another throwable as the cause.

methods.name: ViewHandlerException(String msg, Throwable t)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts both a message and a cause throwable.
